query: Draft a onesheet for Facilitron Streaming aimed at athletic directors for MCR-265 — a single-page sell sheet we can render to a branded PDF.
expected_behavior: Pulls product context from the Jira ticket and tron:confluence, and uses AskUserQuestion only for the target audience and the single primary CTA when unclear
Structures the draft to fit one page: headline + one-line positioning, subhead, 3 value props (benefits not features), a 3-step How it works, a single proof block, and a Get started CTA
Uses only real proof points (metrics, customer names, integrations) and flags any unsupported claim or missing proof with > TODO: rather than inventing it
Produces copy with no em dashes (Facilitron voice), ruthlessly tight (3 value props, 3 steps, 1 proof block)
Publishes the structured markdown to the preselected Drive or Confluence destination, then gives it to tron:md-to-pdf with a separately resolved durable PDF destination
Stays git-free, routes any hero/visual through tron:gen-image or tron:figma-to-imagekit, and confirms before producing the final PDF
